assets.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational
Asset type: illustration for a middle-school discussion activity, justified retention of a proposal after considering another idea.
Create a left-to-right objects-only comparison. On the left, one teal paper proposal card showing exactly a simple desk lamp and a small handled basket containing books. In the middle, a smaller ochre paper speech-bubble card shows a freestanding rectangular room divider and a book basket: this is a counterproposal. Two broad navy paper paths from these cards converge toward an open cream notebook on the right. On the notebook is a teal card showing the same lamp and book basket as the first proposal, alongside two small blank coral note strips. Keep the desk lamp visibly distinct from the tall room divider. This represents retaining the original proposal with a reason after considering the alternative; do not show a winner, approval, or reject the other contribution. Every object fully in frame. Refined flat scissor-cut paper collage for ages 11–13, warm cream background, teal, ochre, coral and muted navy; gently irregular edges and subtle paper grain with tiny layered shadows. Landscape 3:2, generous margins, few large shapes easy to distinguish on a phone. No people, readable words, letters, numbers, checkmarks, trophies, logos or watermark. Not realistic, photographic, or 3D. These are neutral memory cues, not evidence of success. All teaching information will be in editable captions.
assets.alt: Two proposal cards feed into a notebook. Its final card keeps the lamp and book basket; blank notes cue the need to record a reason and a remaining check.
